project_specification.overview: A credit-based pricing and billing system for AutoForge that monetizes the platform as a premium SaaS product. Users purchase typed credits (Standard, Pro, Enterprise) to run builds, with optional BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) reduced pricing, annual platform subscriptions with included credits, usage metering, tier-based rate limiting, and an admin dashboard for revenue and margin analysis. This is an addition to the existing AutoForge codebase, not a standalone application.

frontend.state_management: TanStack Query + React hooks and context (existing)

backend.database: Supabase PostgreSQL (new — billing data requires multi-tenant ACID, RLS)
backend.payments: Stripe API via stripe Python SDK (new dependency)
backend.encryption: cryptography library for BYOK key encryption (new dependency)

communication.api: RESTful endpoints on existing FastAPI server

prerequisites.environment_setup: - Python 3.11+ (existing) - Node.js 20+ (existing) - Stripe account with API keys (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET) - Supabase project with PostgreSQL database (SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY) - Stripe products and prices created for all credit types, bundles, and subscriptions - BYOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY (256-bit AES key for encrypting stored API keys)

core_features.infrastructure: - Database connection to Supabase PostgreSQL established and health-checked on server start - Billing database schema applied: credit_balances, credit_transactions, subscriptions, build_usage, rate_limits, user_api_keys tables with RLS policies - Billing data persists across server restarts (Supabase cloud database) - No mock data patterns in billing codebase (all reads and writes hit Supabase) - Backend billing API queries real Supabase database via supabase-py client
core_features.credit_system: - System adds credits to user balance atomically when purchase completes (transaction + balance update in single operation) - System consumes credits from user balance atomically when build starts (FOR UPDATE row lock prevents double-spend) - System refunds credits to user balance when system crash or queue cancellation occurs - System logs every credit operation as an immutable record in credit_transactions table - Credit balance columns enforce non-negative values via CHECK constraints (balance cannot go below zero) - API endpoint GET /api/billing/balance returns user's current credit counts for all nine credit types - API endpoint GET /api/billing/transactions returns paginated transaction history with type filter (purchase, consume, refund, bonus, grant)
core_features.stripe_integration: - API endpoint POST /api/billing/create-checkout creates a Stripe Checkout Session for one-time credit purchases with credit_type and quantity in metadata - API endpoint POST /api/billing/create-checkout creates a Stripe Checkout Session in subscription mode for annual platform plans - Webhook endpoint POST /api/billing/webhook processes checkout.session.completed events to add credits to user balance - Webhook endpoint processes invoice.paid events to renew subscriptions and grant annual credit allotments - Webhook endpoint processes invoice.payment_failed events to mark subscription status as past_due - Webhook endpoint processes customer.subscription.deleted events to cancel platform access - Webhook endpoint validates Stripe signature on every request and returns 400 for invalid signatures
core_features.build_gating: - System checks user credit balance for the required build type before allowing build to start - System returns "insufficient credits" error with purchase CTA when balance is zero for required credit type - System requires active platform subscription (Starter/Pro/Agency) before allowing any build - Credit deducted atomically when build pipeline actually begins (not on button click) - Queued build cancellation returns the consumed credit to user balance instantly - System auto-refunds credit when build fails due to infrastructure or system error (not bad spec) - Grace period cron job returns unconsumed credits to balance if build not started within 48 hours
core_features.byok: - User can save an Anthropic API key via POST /api/billing/byok/key endpoint - System validates API key by making a minimal test API call before accepting it - API key encrypted with AES-256 before storage (plaintext never persisted or logged) - GET /api/billing/byok/key returns only masked preview (sk-ant-...XXXX) and validation timestamp - User can delete stored API key via DELETE /api/billing/byok/key with confirmation - Agent subprocess receives user API key via environment variable when BYOK mode is selected for a build
core_features.subscriptions: - User can subscribe to Starter annual plan ($999/yr) via Stripe Checkout redirect - User can subscribe to Pro annual plan ($2,499/yr) via Stripe Checkout redirect - User can subscribe to Agency annual plan ($4,999/yr) via Stripe Checkout redirect - System grants tier-specific credits on subscription creation (Starter: 3 standard_web, Pro: 5 pro_dual, Agency: 15 pro_dual + 5 each add-on) - System grants tier-specific credits on each subscription renewal via invoice.paid webhook - User can cancel subscription (platform access continues until current period end)
core_features.usage_metering: - System creates build_usage record with status running when build starts - System tracks total input tokens, output tokens, cache tokens per build session - System tracks total agent sessions and conversation turns per build - System calculates estimated AI cost in cents per build based on token usage - System updates build_usage status to completed, failed, or refunded when build ends
core_features.rate_limiting: - System enforces max concurrent builds per user based on subscription tier (Starter: 1, Pro: 2, Agency: 5 managed; higher for BYOK) - System enforces max daily builds per user based on subscription tier - System enforces max monthly builds per user based on subscription tier (Agency unlimited) - BYOK users receive higher rate limits than managed users at the same tier - Rate limit counters reset automatically (daily counter resets at midnight UTC, monthly at month start) - API returns clear error message with tier upgrade CTA when rate limit is reached
core_features.build_queue: - Builds added to queue when user's concurrent build limit is reached - Queue ordering uses priority: Agency > Pro > Starter, FIFO within same tier - User can cancel a queued build before it starts and receive instant credit refund - Queue position and estimated wait time broadcast to user via WebSocket in real-time
core_features.billing_ui: - Credit balance component in app header shows counts for each credit type the user owns - Pricing page displays plan comparison grid with all credit types, bundle discounts, and BYOK pricing - Purchase modal allows selecting credit type, quantity, and shows bundle discount when applicable - Purchase flow redirects to Stripe Checkout hosted page (PCI-compliant, no card data touches our server) - Success page displayed after returning from Stripe Checkout with updated credit balance - Transaction history page shows paginated table with date, type, credit type, quantity, and description - Transaction history supports filtering by transaction type (purchase, consume, refund, grant) - Empty transaction and credit states show EmptyState component with "Purchase your first credits" CTA
core_features.byok_settings_ui: - BYOK section in settings modal shows API key input field with "Validate & Save" button - Validation success displays masked key preview, provider name, and validation timestamp - Validation failure displays specific error message (invalid key, insufficient permissions, network error) - Delete key button triggers ConfirmModal before removing stored key
core_features.subscription_ui: - Subscription page shows current plan name, status, renewal date, and included credits - Plan comparison grid displays Starter vs Pro vs Agency features, limits, and pricing - Subscribe and upgrade buttons redirect to Stripe Checkout for the selected plan - Cancel subscription button shows ConfirmModal with "access until [date]" messaging
core_features.admin_dashboard: - Admin route /admin requires admin role and returns 403 for non-admin users - Revenue section shows total revenue with daily, weekly, monthly, and all-time breakdowns - Credit velocity section shows credits sold vs consumed over time with chart - Margin analysis section shows average AI cost, revenue, and margin per build type - User analytics section shows total users, active users (30 day), top 10 by revenue, and BYOK adoption rate - Platform health section shows active builds, queue depth, build success rate, and average build duration

tables.credit_balances: - user_id (UUID PRIMARY KEY, FOREIGN KEY -> auth.users) - standard_web (INTEGER DEFAULT 0, CHECK >= 0) - standard_dual (INTEGER DEFAULT 0, CHECK >= 0) - pro_web (INTEGER DEFAULT 0, CHECK >= 0) - pro_dual (INTEGER DEFAULT 0, CHECK >= 0) - enterprise (INTEGER DEFAULT 0, CHECK >= 0) - knowledge_base (INTEGER DEFAULT 0, CHECK >= 0) - security_audit (INTEGER DEFAULT 0, CHECK >= 0) - performance_report (INTEGER DEFAULT 0, CHECK >= 0) - maintenance_months (INTEGER DEFAULT 0, CHECK >= 0) - updated_at (TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()) - RLS: users can only SELECT their own row
tables.credit_transactions: - id (UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()) - user_id (UUID NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY -> auth.users) - type (TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK IN ('purchase', 'consume', 'refund', 'bonus', 'grant')) - credit_type (TEXT NOT NULL) - quantity (INTEGER NOT NULL) - stripe_payment_id (TEXT, nullable) - stripe_checkout_session_id (TEXT, nullable) - project_id (UUID, nullable) - build_id (UUID, nullable) - description (TEXT, nullable) - metadata (JSONB DEFAULT '{}') - created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()) - INDEX on (user_id, created_at DESC) - INDEX on (stripe_payment_id) - RLS: users can only SELECT their own rows
tables.subscriptions: - id (UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()) - user_id (UUID NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY -> auth.users) - stripe_subscription_id (TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL) - stripe_customer_id (TEXT NOT NULL) - plan (TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK IN ('starter_annual', 'pro_annual', 'agency_annual')) - status (TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK IN ('active', 'canceled', 'past_due', 'trialing', 'incomplete')) - current_period_start (TIMESTAMPTZ, nullable) - current_period_end (TIMESTAMPTZ, nullable) - cancel_at_period_end (BOOLEAN DEFAULT false) - created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()) - updated_at (TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()) - INDEX on (user_id) - INDEX on (stripe_subscription_id) - RLS: users can only SELECT their own rows
tables.build_usage: - id (UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()) - project_id (UUID NOT NULL) - user_id (UUID NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY -> auth.users) - build_id (UUID NOT NULL) - credit_type (TEXT NOT NULL) - is_byok (BOOLEAN DEFAULT false) - total_input_tokens (BIGINT DEFAULT 0) - total_output_tokens (BIGINT DEFAULT 0) - total_turns (INTEGER DEFAULT 0) - total_agent_sessions (INTEGER DEFAULT 0) - cache_read_tokens (BIGINT DEFAULT 0) - cache_write_tokens (BIGINT DEFAULT 0) - features_total (INTEGER DEFAULT 0) - features_completed (INTEGER DEFAULT 0) - features_failed (INTEGER DEFAULT 0) - build_start (TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL) - build_end (TIMESTAMPTZ, nullable) - build_duration_minutes (INTEGER, nullable) - estimated_ai_cost_cents (INTEGER DEFAULT 0) - credit_value_cents (INTEGER NOT NULL) - margin_cents (INTEGER DEFAULT 0) - status (TEXT, CHECK IN ('running', 'completed', 'failed', 'refunded')) - created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()) - INDEX on (user_id, created_at DESC) - INDEX on (project_id) - RLS: users can only SELECT their own rows
tables.rate_limits: - user_id (UUID PRIMARY KEY, FOREIGN KEY -> auth.users) - tier (TEXT NOT NULL, CHECK IN ('starter', 'pro', 'agency')) - concurrent_builds (INTEGER DEFAULT 0) - builds_today (INTEGER DEFAULT 0) - builds_this_month (INTEGER DEFAULT 0) - last_build_started_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, nullable) - today_reset_at (DATE DEFAULT current_date) - month_reset_at (DATE DEFAULT date_trunc('month', current_date)) - updated_at (TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now())
tables.user_api_keys: - user_id (UUID PRIMARY KEY, FOREIGN KEY -> auth.users) - encrypted_key (BYTEA NOT NULL) - key_preview (TEXT NOT NULL) - provider (TEXT DEFAULT 'anthropic') - validated_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, nullable) - created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()) - updated_at (TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()) - RLS: users can only manage their own row

postgres_functions.consume_credit: Atomically deducts one credit of the specified type from credit_balances using FOR UPDATE row locking, inserts a consume transaction into credit_transactions, and returns boolean success. Prevents double-spend under concurrent requests.
postgres_functions.refund_credit: Atomically adds one credit back to credit_balances, inserts a refund transaction into credit_transactions with the original build_id reference.
postgres_functions.add_credits: Atomically adds N credits of the specified type to credit_balances, inserts a purchase or grant transaction into credit_transactions with Stripe payment reference.

api_endpoints_summary.billing: - GET /api/billing/balance (returns current credit counts for authenticated user) - GET /api/billing/transactions?page=1&limit=20&type=purchase (paginated transaction history with optional type filter) - POST /api/billing/create-checkout (creates Stripe Checkout session; body: {credit_type, quantity, is_byok} or {plan}) - POST /api/billing/webhook (Stripe webhook receiver; validates signature, processes events) - POST /api/billing/consume (consume a credit for a build; body: {credit_type, project_id, build_id}) - POST /api/billing/refund (refund a credit; body: {build_id, reason})
api_endpoints_summary.byok: - POST /api/billing/byok/key (save and validate API key; body: {api_key, provider}) - GET /api/billing/byok/key (get masked key preview and validation status) - DELETE /api/billing/byok/key (delete stored API key)
api_endpoints_summary.subscriptions: - GET /api/billing/subscription (get current subscription status and plan details) - POST /api/billing/subscription/cancel (cancel subscription at period end)
api_endpoints_summary.rate_limits: - GET /api/billing/rate-limits (get current usage counts and tier limits for authenticated user)
api_endpoints_summary.admin: - GET /api/admin/revenue?period=monthly (revenue breakdown by period) - GET /api/admin/credits (credit velocity: sold vs consumed, outstanding balance) - GET /api/admin/margins (average AI cost, revenue, and margin per build type) - GET /api/admin/users (total, active, top users, BYOK adoption rate) - GET /api/admin/health (active builds, queue depth, success rate, avg duration)

ui_layout.main_structure: - Existing AutoForge header augmented with CreditBalance component showing credit counts - New /pricing route with plan comparison grid and purchase CTAs - New /billing route with transaction history table - BYOK section added to existing SettingsModal - Subscription management section added to existing SettingsModal or new /subscription route - New /admin route (hidden from nav, requires admin role) with revenue and analytics dashboard - BuildQueue component shown inline when user has queued builds

design_system.color_palette: - Existing AutoForge neobrutalism design system (Tailwind CSS v4 tokens) - Credit type colors: Standard (blue-500), Pro (purple-500), Enterprise (amber-500) - Balance positive: green-500, Balance zero: gray-400 - Revenue up: green-500, Revenue down: red-500 - Subscription active: green-500, past_due: amber-500, canceled: gray-400
design_system.typography: - Follows existing AutoForge typography (Inter, system-ui, sans-serif) - Credit counts: font-mono tabular-nums for aligned number display - Price display: font-semibold text-lg for emphasis

ui_ux_standards.banned_patterns: - alert(), confirm(), prompt() - Use modals and toasts instead - Text-only empty states - Use EmptyState component with icon + CTA - Loading states that just say "Loading..." - Use skeleton loaders - Delete without confirmation - Always use ConfirmModal (especially for key deletion and subscription cancellation) - Raw timestamps - Format as relative time - Displaying full API keys - Always mask to sk-ant-...XXXX - Client-side rate limit enforcement - All limits checked server-side
ui_ux_standards.required_components: - Modal for purchase flow and plan selection - ConfirmModal for subscription cancellation and API key deletion - Toast notifications for purchase success, refund, and error states - Skeleton loader for credit balance, transaction history, and admin charts - EmptyState for zero credits and empty transaction history - Button with loading state for all purchase and subscription actions
ui_ux_standards.page_patterns: - Pricing page is read-only (no edit mode needed) - Transaction history is read-only list with filters (no detail view needed for individual transactions) - Subscription management: view current plan -> upgrade/cancel actions - Admin dashboard: read-only metrics with time period selectors
ui_ux_standards.feedback_protocol: - Purchase success: toast "Credits added to your balance" + redirect to dashboard - Purchase cancel: toast "Purchase cancelled" + stay on pricing page - Credit consumed: no toast (build start flow handles messaging) - Refund: toast "Credit refunded to your balance" - Rate limit hit: inline error with tier upgrade CTA - API key validation success: toast "API key validated and saved" - API key validation failure: inline error with specific message - Subscription cancelled: toast "Subscription cancelled. Access until [date]"
ui_ux_standards.polish_requirements: - Credit counts animate on change (count up/down transition) - Bundle discounts show original price with strikethrough and savings percentage - Transaction amounts show + for additions and - for deductions with color coding - Admin charts support date range selection and are responsive
ui_ux_standards.accessibility_basics: - Focus rings on all interactive elements - Escape closes purchase and confirmation modals - aria-labels on icon-only buttons (delete key, cancel subscription) - Form labels on API key input and quantity selectors - Screen reader announcement for credit balance changes

coding_standards.architecture: - New FastAPI routers in server/routers/billing.py and server/routers/admin.py - New services in server/services/billing_service.py, server/services/byok_service.py - New React components in ui/src/components/billing/ directory - New API client functions in ui/src/lib/billing-api.ts - New React Query hooks in ui/src/hooks/useBilling.ts - New TypeScript types in ui/src/lib/types.ts (extend existing file) - Supabase client initialized in server/services/supabase_client.py - All Stripe Price IDs loaded from environment variables (never hardcoded) - All billing database writes go through service layer (not direct from routers)
coding_standards.security: - Stripe webhook signature validated on every webhook request - Credit operations use Postgres row-level locking (FOR UPDATE) to prevent race conditions - BYOK API keys encrypted with AES-256 before storage, never logged or returned in full - Admin endpoints enforce admin role server-side via Supabase RLS - Rate limits enforced server-side only (frontend shows limits but does not enforce) - Idempotency keys (stripe_payment_id) prevent duplicate credit grants from webhook retries
coding_standards.error_handling: - Stripe API errors return user-friendly messages (not raw Stripe error objects) - Credit consumption failures return specific error (insufficient balance, rate limited, no subscription) - Webhook processing failures are logged but return 200 to Stripe (to prevent retry storms for unrecoverable errors) - BYOK validation errors distinguish between invalid key, network error, and permission issues

key_interactions.purchase_credits_flow: 1. User navigates to /pricing page 2. User sees plan comparison grid with credit types and bundle options 3. User clicks "Buy Credits" on desired credit type 4. Purchase modal opens with quantity selector and bundle discount preview 5. User selects quantity and clicks "Checkout" 6. Frontend calls POST /api/billing/create-checkout with credit_type and quantity 7. Backend creates Stripe Checkout Session and returns URL 8. Frontend redirects to Stripe hosted checkout page 9. User completes payment on Stripe 10. Stripe fires checkout.session.completed webhook 11. Backend webhook handler adds credits to user balance and logs transaction 12. User redirected to success page showing updated credit balance
key_interactions.start_gated_build_flow: 1. User clicks "Start Build" on a project 2. System checks: user has active subscription? (if no, redirect to pricing) 3. System checks: user has sufficient credits for selected build type? (if no, show purchase modal) 4. System checks: user within rate limits? (if no, show rate limit error with upgrade CTA) 5. System checks: concurrent build slots available? (if no, add to queue with position display) 6. System atomically consumes one credit of the required type 7. System creates build_usage record with status running 8. Agent pipeline starts; build proceeds normally 9. On completion: build_usage updated with token counts, cost, and status 10. On system crash: auto-refund triggered, credit returned to balance
key_interactions.byok_setup_flow: 1. User opens Settings modal and navigates to BYOK section 2. User enters their Anthropic API key in the input field 3. User clicks "Validate & Save" 4. System makes a test API call to validate the key 5. On success: key encrypted and stored, masked preview shown, toast "Key validated and saved" 6. On failure: inline error with specific message (invalid key, network error, etc.) 7. Next build start: user offered choice between "Use my API key" (BYOK pricing) and "Use AutoForge AI" (full pricing)

step.title: Database Schema and Supabase Client
step.tasks: - Create Supabase migration with all six billing tables (credit_balances, credit_transactions, subscriptions, build_usage, rate_limits, user_api_keys) - Create RLS policies for each table (users read/manage own data only) - Create Postgres functions: consume_credit, refund_credit, add_credits - Create server/services/supabase_client.py with Supabase Python client initialization - Add supabase-py, stripe, and cryptography to requirements.txt

step.title: Credit Service and Billing API
step.tasks: - Create server/services/billing_service.py with credit operations (add, consume, refund, balance, transactions) - Create server/routers/billing.py with REST endpoints (balance, transactions, consume, refund) - Add billing router to FastAPI app - Add billing TypeScript types to ui/src/lib/types.ts - Create ui/src/lib/billing-api.ts with API client functions - Create ui/src/hooks/useBilling.ts with React Query hooks

step.title: Stripe Integration
step.tasks: - Add create-checkout endpoint to billing router (one-time and subscription modes) - Add webhook endpoint with Stripe signature validation - Implement webhook handlers for checkout.session.completed, invoice.paid, invoice.payment_failed, customer.subscription.deleted - Add idempotency checks using stripe_payment_id - Add Stripe environment variables to configuration

step.title: Build Gating and Refunds
step.tasks: - Integrate credit balance check into build start flow (parallel_orchestrator.py) - Implement atomic credit consumption on build pipeline start - Add automatic refund on system crash detection - Implement 48-hour grace period check (cron or on-demand) - Add queue cancellation refund logic

step.title: BYOK and Subscriptions
step.tasks: - Create server/services/byok_service.py with key validation, encryption, storage - Add BYOK endpoints to billing router - Modify client.py to support user-provided API keys via environment variable - Implement subscription management service (create, renew, cancel, credit grants) - Add subscription endpoints to billing router

step.title: Rate Limiting and Build Queue
step.tasks: - Implement rate limiting service with tier-based concurrent, daily, monthly limits - Integrate rate limit checks into build start flow - Implement build queue with priority ordering - Add WebSocket broadcast for queue position updates - Implement automatic counter resets (daily and monthly)

step.title: Usage Metering
step.tasks: - Instrument agent.py to track token usage per session - Create build_usage records on build start, update on completion - Calculate estimated AI cost based on token counts and model pricing - Calculate margin (credit value minus estimated AI cost) - Track feature completion counts per build

step.title: Billing UI Components
step.tasks: - Create CreditBalance header component with credit type counts - Create PricingPage with plan comparison grid, credit types, and bundle options - Create PurchaseModal with credit type selection, quantity input, and Stripe redirect - Create checkout success page with updated balance display - Create TransactionHistory page with pagination and type filters - Add billing routes to App.tsx

step.title: BYOK and Subscription UI
step.tasks: - Add BYOKSettings section to SettingsModal with key input, validation, and masked preview - Create SubscriptionPage with current plan display and plan comparison - Add subscribe, upgrade, and cancel flows with Stripe redirect and ConfirmModal - Add BuildQueue component for queue position display

step.title: Admin Dashboard
step.tasks: - Create server/routers/admin.py with admin-only endpoints (role check enforced) - Implement revenue, credit velocity, margin, user analytics, and platform health queries - Create AdminDashboard page with Recharts visualizations - Add time period selectors for revenue and credit charts - Add /admin route with admin role guard

success_criteria.functionality: - Users can purchase credits via Stripe Checkout and see balance update immediately - Credits are consumed atomically when builds start (no double-spend possible) - BYOK users can save encrypted API keys and use them for builds at reduced pricing - Annual subscriptions grant correct credits on creation and renewal - Rate limits enforce concurrent, daily, and monthly build caps by tier - Build queue orders by tier priority and provides real-time position updates - Admin dashboard shows accurate revenue, credit velocity, margins, and user analytics - Automatic refunds process correctly for system errors and queue cancellations - 48-hour grace period returns unconsumed credits
success_criteria.user_experience: - Credit balance visible at all times in the header - Pricing page clearly shows all options with bundle savings - Purchase flow is smooth: select → checkout → success with no page reload jank - Transaction history is filterable and paginates correctly - BYOK setup provides clear validation feedback - Rate limit errors show specific limits and upgrade path - Queue position updates in real-time without page refresh
success_criteria.technical_quality: - Zero console errors in browser - All credit operations are atomic (Postgres transactions with row locking) - Stripe webhook signature validated on every request - BYOK keys encrypted at rest, never logged or returned in full - No mock data patterns — all billing data reads from Supabase - Admin endpoints enforce role server-side (not just frontend route guard) - Idempotent webhook handling prevents duplicate credit grants - TypeScript strict mode with no any types in billing code - Python code passes ruff lint and mypy type checks
